description: Hand-authored ground truth for rust-minimal synthetic fixture. Every edge is observable in source. Used by the prove-the-instrument gate before running real baselines.
notes: 6 internal CALLS, 2 internal IMPORTS. The workspace has 2 crates ('rust-minimal' and 'rust_minimal'): the bin and lib share the same Cargo.toml but the oracle sees them as 2 crate-like units because they're 2 Cargo [[bin]]/[lib] targets. Free-function callee names (square, greet, leaf, helper, entry, inner_greet) are bare syntactic paths — the internal-fn-defs set catches them. 'greet' is imported from rust_minimal::helpers::greet and called as `greet("world")` — oracle will emit bare `greet`, the fn-defs set contains 'greet', keeps it.
